Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 activities on human single-protein target CHEMBL3474 (Phospholipase A2, membrane associated) that have exact standard relation '=' and non-null pChEMBL values. Join molecule_dictionary, activities, assays, target_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL3474, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Order results by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id.
